about_the_game:
Once, children sang in the fields. Now the wind only whispers names of the dead.
Velmora — a village on the edge of light and shadow. And today... you've come back.

Not as a hero. Not even as a man seeking redemption.
But as the only one who knows what lies beneath the chapel floor.

The sacred statue of light is gone.
The crypt is stirring.
And somewhere in the dark waits Selena Mortis — the one death has long forgotten.

⚔️ Features

  • Atmospheric action-adventure with a story-focused experience

  • Melee combat against those who should have stayed buried

  • Cinematic dialogue and voiced characters with secrets of their own

  • Hidden keys, ancient scrolls and lost places beneath the ruins

  • Retro Mode for lower-end machines — same shadows, fewer shaders

  • No hand-holding, no map — just instinct and flickering light

  • Beyond Velmora lies a secret… if you remember the name.

🌑 Final Word

The Curse of Velmora is not a game about glory.
It’s about whether you still carry enough light to descend — and return.

🙋‍♂️ A Note from the Developer

This is my very first released game.
It was created during an intense three-month solo sprint — fueled by stubbornness, too much coffee, and just enough darkness.

There’s still work to be done.
But I believe that if you've ever walked through ruins in your dreams — Velmora will feel strangely familiar.

And if Velmora lives on...
You'll feel it in the updates — deeper secrets in the crypt, and a quest that just might not end where you think it does.

Thanks for playing. Really.
